purpose: Compare AtomFab's decision and evidence layer with current specialist models, public scientific benchmarks, conventional acquisition policies, and process-twin baselines.

no_sota_claim_until: the official task and split are reproduced
the exact baseline model/tool version and configuration are pinned
test/train overlap is audited where feasible
equal budgets and target definitions are used for policy comparisons
all failed runs and exclusions are reported
metrics are independently recomputed from raw predictions or traceable outputs
claim_policy.rule: Novel architecture, high source-code volume, or internal test success is not evidence of state-of-the-art performance.

benchmark_lanes.goal: Reproduce task-level atomistic metrics and derived-observable behavior on a tractable, license-compatible MS25 subset.
baselines: Published MS25 reference results using the exact declared reference method, settings and subset.

Choose the strongest compatible pinned pretrained potential from the public Matbench Discovery model catalog; candidate pool includes MatRIS-10M-OAM, eSEN-30M-OAM, Orb-v3, MatterSim-v1.5M, and MACE-MP-0/OMAT variants, subject to species, dataset, license, precision and hardware compatibility.
One simpler domain-appropriate baseline where scientifically meaningful.
Policy ablation: same potential/evaluator with the selection/evidence layer disabled.
metrics: typed failure-mode counts by model/material family/split/severity, with abstentions reported separately
per-family transferability and declared applicability-domain violations, not only pooled error
derived-observable error and violation rates (lattice/volume/barrier or task-relevant outputs) by failure category
failure-mode rates scoped by evaluation stratum (e.g., particle size × support surface × temperature regime), with the scope digest retained
gates: reproduce a published baseline within its reported tolerance
preserve exact reference method and units
group correlated configurations by parent material
report failures and exclusions
retain every tested sample disposition (pass, failed, abstained) and never omit failed/non-converged samples from aggregate denominators
publish critical failure counts and grouped family-holdout results beside MAE/RMSE; a good average cannot compensate for catastrophic failures
use a frozen failure taxonomy and evaluator digest; summary counts must recompute from record-level evidence with no mixed model/split/family pooling
report each evaluation stratum separately before any cross-stratum aggregate; no result may pool particle sizes, support surfaces or thermodynamic regimes into one hidden rate

benchmark_lanes.goal: Measure competitiveness on the official high-throughput crystal stability task.
baselines: Current official Matbench Discovery leaderboard models, pinning the exact checkpoint, metadata and evaluator version.
Candidate current catalog models include MatRIS-10M-OAM, eSEN-30M-OAM, Orb-v3, MatterSim-v1.5M and MACE variants when their task coverage and use terms permit.
A published or simpler baseline from the official benchmark protocol.
gates: use the official evaluator and fixed split
only compare scores with matching compliance labels
do not infer overall manufacturing performance from a stability score

benchmark_lanes.goal: Test whether model selection, uncertainty and abstention improve agreement with experimental properties.

reference.name: UniFFBench / MinX
reference.scope: 1500+ mineral systems, 85 elements, experimental reference measurements

baselines: pinned universal MLIP baselines from the benchmark
metrics: risk-coverage curve and stepwise AURC for uncertainty-based abstention
AURC against random-uncertainty and shuffled-uncertainty negative controls at identical retained coverages
risk-at-nearest-attainable 50%, 75%, 90%, and 100% coverage points without splitting equal-uncertainty groups
measurement-vs-prediction discrepancy and failure/abstention category by material/environment family
gates: respect experimental reference uncertainty
separate in-domain from OOD cases
do not label simulation outputs as measurement
freeze uncertainty construction and any abstention threshold on validation data; report the complete risk-coverage curve and AURC on a disjoint test set
publish risk and realized coverage at nominal 50%, 75%, 90%, and 100% coverage points; preserve equal-uncertainty groups even when realized coverage differs from nominal
separate prediction, simulation, measurement and independent reproduction result classes; never reinterpret simulated sensor values as measurement evidence

benchmark_lanes.goal: Test whether potential-guided search recovers correct structures and energetic hierarchy under perturbed geometries.

reference.name: 2026 universal interatomic potential EOS and minima-hopping benchmark

baselines: simple local/random search baseline where applicable
gates: separate equilibrium and far-from-equilibrium reports
count failed and duplicated searches
validate energetic rankings against the declared reference method

benchmark_lanes.goal: Separate energy-prediction accuracy from structural exploration quality for supported nanoparticle searches, measuring whether a potential-guided search finds diverse, physically valid low-energy structures rather than merely assigning accurate energies to a limited set of structures.

reference.name: 2026 supported-nanoparticle uMLIP structural-exploration benchmark / UniAlCu
reference.scope: Supported nanoparticle systems; exact compositions, support surfaces, configurations, data license and reference method must be pinned before execution.

baselines: Published reference protocol and DFT-relaxed structures for the chosen systems.
A strong pinned universal interatomic potential compatible with the selected elements and interfaces.
A simple randomized or local-search baseline with the same starting candidates, DFT budget and stopping rule.
The same potential and search algorithm with Symthaea candidate selection disabled.
Ablation where ranking uses predicted energy only, without structural-diversity or uncertainty criteria.
metrics: reference energetic-ordering accuracy on matched structures
top-weighted finite-prefix ranking overlap (normalized RBO-style, p=0.94) restricted to shared canonical candidate IDs; report candidate-set Jaccard separately
candidate-set Jaccard overlap between predicted and reference candidate sets
unique low-energy minima found at equal reference-calculation budget
structural diversity and duplicate-minimum rate under a pinned deduplication tolerance
fraction of candidates satisfying geometry and interface validity constraints
energy error conditional on structure recovery
search cost per unique validated low-energy structure
best validated objective and learning curve at equal cost
Pareto frontier over unique reference-validated low-energy structures, best validated objective, and total cost; do not collapse these dimensions into one weighted score
typed structural-search failure modes: non-convergence, geometry collapse, interatomic overlap, support/interface breakdown, non-finite force, out-of-domain recommendation, and abstention
failure-mode rates scoped by evaluation stratum (e.g., particle size × support surface × temperature regime), with the scope digest retained
published reference-search reproduction on 12 explicit strata: Cu27/Cu38/Cu47/Cu55 × γ-Al2O3(100)/γ-Al2O3(110)/α-Al2O3(0001)
reference-method/checkpoint/data-manifest completeness and checksum coverage before claim-bearing execution

paper-compatible budget: 50 lowest-energy candidates per MLIP locally DFT-optimized per stratum; record the original candidate pool, failed refinements, duplicates and resulting unique validated discoveries
distinct budget for the policy-extension phase: matched per-policy reference budget over at least 20 paired seeds, with router/preprocessing/retry costs included
paper-reported search-winner fingerprint by model across 12 size×surface systems, reported as reference context rather than a deterministic requirement under different stochastic seeds

paper-compatible extrapolated RBO with persistence p=0.94 and Kendall tau-b on identical canonical candidate IDs, reported separately from discovery-set Jaccard and the finite-prefix RBO-style internal metric
gates: report energy accuracy and structural exploration as separate score families

canonicalize and deduplicate structure identities with a frozen tolerance before ranking comparison; candidate IDs must be stable across policies, and unmatched candidates count as discovery differences rather than being silently remapped
pin particle composition, support surface, slab construction, relaxation settings and structural deduplication method before testing
group related configurations by parent nanoparticle/support system when defining held-out splits
count failed relaxations, duplicate minima, and invalid interfaces rather than silently excluding them
compare search policies at equal reference-calculation budgets and include a strong pretrained potential
do not generalize from the chosen supported-nanoparticle family to universal catalyst performance
report the nondominated policy set per matched seed; hard-constraint violations make an outcome ineligible rather than tradeable against discovery quality or cost
report failure and abstention distributions by particle size and support surface; do not report a search as efficient by excluding failed relaxations or invalid interfaces
report each evaluation stratum separately before any cross-stratum aggregate; no result may pool particle sizes, support surfaces or thermodynamic regimes into one hidden rate
reproduce the published GA/reference protocol, including population 50, 20 generations, random initial population, cut-and-splice and mutation, after pinning every remaining method setting
preserve the 12 per-size/per-surface strata; keep the 2025 related Zenodo training/validation/global-minima archive distinct from the exact 2026 benchmark evaluation manifest
no claim-bearing run until exact DFT settings, candidate/reference structure manifest, model checkpoints, licenses, evaluator version and SHA-256 artifact digests are pinned

report the published reproduction phase separately from the policy-extension phase; do not infer exact candidate counts from population × generations when code-level duplicate/offspring accounting has not been pinned

for the extension stretch claim, use paired seeds and identical frozen targets; if either policy fails to reach the target, target-reaching acceleration is undefined for that pair and the failure remains in the report

never label a finite GA best-known structure as the true global minimum unless exhaustive/certifying evidence supports that claim; record random seeds and deviations from paper-reported winner counts without tuning the evaluator
pin both mutation operators and their probabilities, including rattle/mirror weighting, before exact reproduction
match the published ranking comparison by applying RBO p=0.94 and tie-aware Kendall tau-b to the same reference-DFT-refined candidate universe; keep discovery-set overlap as a separate metric
pin the canonical-ID tie-break for exact RBO ties and the predeclared energy tie tolerance for Kendall tau-b before evaluating held-out results

benchmark_lanes.goal: Measure adsorption and relaxation quality when a catalytic-material use case is selected.
baselines: current available pretrained potential under matched settings
gates: do not compare metrics across non-equivalent leaderboards
freeze data/model version and relaxation protocol

benchmark_lanes.goal: Isolate whether Symthaea's decision layer improves candidate selection when physics outputs are held constant.

reference.name: Frozen labelled subset with retrospective masked queries

metrics: best validated objective at equal cost
risk-coverage AURC at matched coverage and budget
coverage and false-feasible count alongside selective risk; abstention is not free success
matched-seed Pareto frontier over validated objective quality, unique reference-validated discoveries, and declared total cost
paired median acceleration factor and percentile bootstrap interval across all predeclared matched seeds
number of predeclared seed pairs reaching the same target under both policies; non-reaching pairs block target-reaching confidence intervals
paired target-reach rate and candidate-minus-baseline reach-rate difference with percentile-bootstrap interval over every predeclared seed, including failed and incomplete campaigns
gates: freeze target and budget before campaigns
at least 20 fixed seeds for a strong comparative claim when feasible
matched target costs
report full curves and confidence intervals
no win unless quality is at least as good at equal budget
compare uncertainty-ranked selection against random-score and shuffled-score negative controls; report retained coverage and risk together
report realized coverage at nominal 50%, 75%, 90%, and 100% operating points; never split equal-uncertainty ties to hit a nominal coverage exactly
publish nondominated policies and per-dimension trade-offs; never use a single weighted score to hide discovery, quality, or cost regressions
bootstrap acceleration intervals require at least 20 predeclared paired seeds and every pair must reach the same frozen target; never drop non-reaching seeds to create a success-only interval
pin confidence level, resample count and bootstrap seed; a speedup claim requires the 95% percentile-bootstrap lower bound above 1 and no worse validated objective quality at equal total cost
pin ensemble checkpoints and calibrate disagreement on validation-only data; include inference cost and compare against shuffled-disagreement controls
counterexample-guided policy must predeclare falsifiable hypotheses and score every proposed counterexample against the reference evaluator; no post-hoc target changes
publish target-reachability counts and paired discordant outcomes over the full predeclared seed roster; failed/incomplete runs count as not reaching target and are never omitted from this endpoint

benchmark_lanes.goal: Validate process feasibility and fault response on a simulation-only surrogate workcell.
baselines: Symthaea decision policy with process feedback ablated
metrics: decision/reason-code parity over the frozen 15-case atomfab-workcell-fault-corpus-v1; report runtime-integrated versus specification-only cases separately
gates: zero false-feasible accepts on the frozen adversarial hard-constraint suite
undefined false-feasible rate when no cases are accepted
every rejection has a reason
synthetic validity must not be presented as hardware validation

execute all 15 corpus cases against the exact pinned workcell/adapter build; require zero false-feasible accepts, explicit rejection reasons, expected parity for typed adapter cases, and accepted in-domain controls

benchmark_lanes.goal: Test prediction-to-measurement gap on a supervised physical material process.

reference.name: Prospectively selected and independently measured samples

baselines: declared conventional planning or expert baseline
gates: pre-register protocol and exclusions
independent instrumentation/interlocks
operator approval
calibration and sample provenance
independent characterization

benchmark_lanes.goal: Select the next evidence action for a declared decision, balancing calibrated expected decision-loss reduction against cost without allowing one evidence domain to substitute for another.

reference.name: Supported-nanoparticle structural-exploration benchmark and materials active-learning strategy benchmark

baselines: Cost-aware expected information gain or calibrated value of information
metrics: best reference-validated objective at equal total cost
unique reference-validated discoveries per total cost
target-reaching acceleration only when both paired routes reach the same frozen target
decision-loss reduction estimate calibration and residual error
selected-action regret against a retrospective oracle on fully labelled runs
action/fidelity mix, abstention rate and OOD rejection rate
failed-action and rework costs included in total cost
Pareto frontier across validated discoveries, best validated objective, and total cost
domain/action-kind mismatch, stale-calibration, prerequisite-block and over-budget rejection counts
gates: compare routes only within the same request, evidence domain, decision contract, units, and budget
calibrate expected decision-loss reduction estimates on disjoint validation campaigns before routing a prospective campaign
atomistic, process-twin, and metrology actions must be benchmarked as separate decision domains; none may be scored as a substitute for another
run fixed-fidelity, random, uncertainty-only, cost-aware, and Symthaea policies under matched seeds and total-cost accounting
include a negative control with shuffled value estimates and an OOD action with inflated uncalibrated value; neither may win
report all failed/incomplete actions, valid abstentions, and target failures; no action selected is not a success unless abstention is the preregistered correct decision
freeze target, total cost unit/resolution, calibration split, and stopping rule before test campaigns

policy_baselines.definition: Uniform selection from the eligible candidate pool with fixed seeds.
Select candidates to maximize a predeclared geometric/feature-space diversity objective.
Select candidates with highest calibrated predictive uncertainty.
Select by expected target improvement or information value divided by measured evaluation cost.
Preregistered AtomFab policy using evidence, constraints, uncertainty and history.
Same policy with the specific claimed advantage disabled; matched model, budget and seeds.
Select among eligible candidates by calibrated disagreement across pinned compatible potential checkpoints; normalize disagreement using held-out validation and charge all model-inference cost.

Select candidates to falsify the current best-ranked structure, model-domain assumptions, or process-feasibility hypothesis; freeze the falsification objective before evaluation and report all counterexamples and failed searches.

accelerations.precondition: same preregistered target, matched query cost model, equal final-quality requirement
